name: Marketing Expense Posting Policy
content: Marketing and advertising spend is posted to GL account 0000400000 (Marketing Expenses). Travel and entertainment costs are posted to GL account 0000470000. Each expense line must carry the responsible cost center. Amounts are debits unless explicitly stated as a credit/refund. All postings are in company code SG01 and currency SGD.

name: IT Cost Allocation Policy
content: Software subscription and cloud costs map to GL account 0000417000 (IT Services). Hardware purchases below the capitalization threshold map to GL account 0000465000. Use cost center C000000301 for shared IT services unless a project cost center is provided in the source.
